methods.name: Multi-temporal intensity correlation method
methods.summary: A multi-temporal landslide detection method that compares the intensity correlation of a co-event pair against a reference group of pre-event pairs. It uses Kernel Density Estimation (KDE) to estimate the probability density function of the reference group and calculates the probability of landslides pixel-by-pixel based on the cumulative density function.
methods.verbatim: In this study, we designed the landslide detection algorithms utilizing coherent and incoherent sources from the SLC stack... we also developed multi-temporal algorithms using the coherence, intensity, and intensity correlation.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is mentioned but not linked, and the custom code used for the multi-temporal intensity correlation method is not provided via any repository or persistent link.
